versions.changelog:
- Initial release: transforms consultation into an interactive, personalized water purifier buying guide.
- Interviews users about water source, contaminants, household size, usage, infrastructure, and region.
- Analyzes answers to recommend precise purification technology, capacity, flow rate, and certification needs.
- Gives unbiased, brand-neutral advice so users can independently assess water purifiers.
- Designed to avoid sales influence, jargon, and overspending; adapts to users’ technical background.
